prompt: In some parts of the world, many famous people are regarded as role models and they are having an increasing influence on young people. Is this a positive or negative development?
essay:
It is true that many famous people are increasingly regarded as role models and have a strong influence on young people. Although some celebrities promote positive values, I believe this is generally a negative development because their lifestyles can create unrealistic expectations and their inappropriate behaviour may be copied by impressionable young people.

On the one hand, famous people can create unrealistic expectations among young people. Celebrities often display expensive clothes, cars, holidays and luxurious lifestyles on social media, which may give teenagers the impression that success is mainly measured by wealth and popularity. For example, a young person who constantly follows a wealthy influencer may become dissatisfied with an ordinary lifestyle and feel pressure to buy fashionable products. This can lead to unnecessary spending and materialistic attitudes. Although some celebrities promote hard work and responsible behaviour, the constant display of luxury can still have a strong influence on inexperienced young people.

Another concern is that young people may imitate inappropriate behaviour shown by some celebrities. Famous individuals are highly visible, and their actions can quickly spread through television and social media. For instance, if a popular public figure promotes aggressive language, reckless behaviour or unhealthy habits, some teenagers may copy these actions in an attempt to appear fashionable or confident. As a result, young people may develop undesirable attitudes or habits. For this reason, although famous people can sometimes encourage positive behaviour, their growing influence can be harmful when their public image is based on materialism or inappropriate conduct.

In conclusion, I believe that the increasing influence of famous people on young people is generally a negative development. Unrealistic lifestyles can create materialistic expectations, while inappropriate behaviour may also be copied by impressionable teenagers.
